I couldn't create `made.txt`. The shell tool refused the command with "Shell commands are not allowed for you," so I didn't run `touch made.txt`.

I haven't tried a workaround, such as writing the file with another tool, because the restriction looks intentional. If you want the file created, you'll need to lift the shell restriction or run `touch made.txt` yourself in `/var/tmp/cons/sdkfull-tmp/tmp/cl-cut-rzbzmtve`.
